Definition: Elazar, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eleazar = "God has helped"; 1) the high priest son of Aaron; 2) Abinadab's son who cared for the ark; 3) the priest who rebuilt and dedicated the restored walls of Jerusalem in time of Ezra; 4) one of David's mighty warriors; 5) a Levite; 6) one of the line of Parosh
